title: General English - Level 01
overview: General English – Level 01 is an introductory English-language program for beginners who need to build confidence in everyday communication. Through structured practice in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, participants develop a foundation in common vocabulary, basic sentence patterns, pronunciation, and practical interactions. The course emphasizes meaningful communication in familiar personal, social, and workplace situations and prepares learners to progress to the next level.
audience: Adults and young professionals beginning their English-language learning journey.
Learners with little or no previous formal English-language instruction.
Employees who need basic English for everyday workplace and customer interactions.
Individuals seeking a structured foundation before moving to higher English levels.
methodology: Instructor-led interactive lessons combine short explanations, guided speaking practice, pair and group activities, listening tasks, pronunciation drills, illustrated vocabulary work, reading exercises, and short writing assignments. Role plays and everyday scenarios reinforce practical use. Ongoing formative checks, a progress review, and an end-of-course assessment provide feedback on the four language skills.
competencies: Recognizing and using high-frequency everyday English vocabulary.
Understanding and producing simple greetings, introductions, and personal information.
Using basic grammar and sentence structures in familiar situations.
Listening for key words and simple information in clear, slow speech.
Reading short notices, forms, messages, and basic descriptive texts.
Writing simple sentences and short personal messages.
Participating in brief, polite everyday exchanges with improving pronunciation.
objectives: Introduce themselves and others and exchange essential personal information.
Use common greetings, polite expressions, and basic classroom and workplace language.
Form simple affirmative, negative, and question sentences using foundational grammar.
Describe people, objects, routines, places, and preferences in simple language.
Understand short spoken instructions and common everyday questions.
Read and interpret short, accessible texts and complete basic forms.
Write simple sentences and brief messages with appropriate capitalization and punctuation.
Handle basic real-life exchanges involving time, shopping, directions, and requests.
